raw_text: Next.js TypeScript app in `src` (App Router); UI `src/components`, hooks `src/hooks`, utilities `src/lib`, routes `src/app`, API `src/app/api/*`, assets `public/`, scripts `scripts/`, Vite app `vite-base-template/`. Commands: `npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev`; `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`. Strict TypeScript, `noEmit: true`, alias `@/*`→`src/*`; 2 spaces; PascalCase components, camelCase variables/functions, kebab-case files. Tailwind v4. No test runner; prefer Vitest/Jest + React Testing Library; tests beside source or `__tests__/`; cover critical paths. Commits imperative/scoped. PRs must include summary/rationale, local test steps/screenshots for UI, linked issues, checklist. Use `.env.local`; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` client-exposed. Rotate leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys. Rewrites `/iframe/*` to `src/app/api/iframe`.
